name: Khyati Global Ventures Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Khyati Global Ventures Ltd exports and repacks a range of FMCG products, including food, non-food items, household products, and festive handicrafts.[1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio[1]
1. Food Stuff
Ready-to-cook packets, Rice, Pulses, Biscuits, Spices, Grains, Flours, Oil, Ghee,
Pickles, Sauces, Jams, Snacks- Namkeen and Sweet, Beverages, Mouth fresheners
etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.19 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.70 Cr.
Working capital days have increased from 39.6 days to 74.2 days
